headline: 2015 executive order freezes U.S.-held property of certain people tied to the situation in Venezuela and bars them from entering the U.S.
what_it_does: This order blocks, or freezes, property in the United States belonging to certain people found to be contributing to the situation in Venezuela. It also suspends those people's ability to enter the United States. The title does not say exactly who qualifies or what conduct counts.

who_it_affects.group: People named or chosen under the order as contributing to the situation in Venezuela
who_it_affects.how: Their property under U.S. control can be frozen, and they can be barred from entering the United States.
They would generally be expected to stop dealing with the frozen property of people covered by the order.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 8, 2015; no separate start date was provided in the source material.
